description: Run one or more replay scripts as a serial test suite Streams progress; no fixed client timeout.

bundleUrl.description: Bundle URL hint inherited by each test session.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

metroHost.description: Metro/debug host hint inherited by each test session.

metroPort.description: Metro/debug port hint inherited by each test session.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

testIme.description: Activate the headless Android test IME for the sessions each suite attempt opens (default on for emulators; opt-in on real devices).

name: test
